sloka: संवाहन्त्य: समापेतुर्नार्यो रुचिरलोचना: ।परिमृज्य तथान्योन्यं पाययन्ति वराङ्गना: ॥ २.९१.५३॥
transliteration: saṁvāhantya: samāpeturnāryo ruciralocanā: ।parimṛjya tathānyonyaṁ pāyayanti varāṅganā: ॥ 2.91.53॥

translations.english: 'O wine drinkers, drink as much as you can those who are hungry partake payasam and sacred meat'.
